asmc.observation: Dry weather and cloudy conditions were observed over the southern ASEAN region overnight, except for some showers observed over the northern parts of Sumatra, Borneo, and parts of central Peninsular Malaysia. Widespread hotspots were detected in the southern parts of Kalimantan and Sumatra, while few hotspots were detected elsewhere in the southern ASEAN region. Moderate to dense smoke haze was observed to cover over parts of Kalimantan, Singapore, the southern parts of Peninsular Malaysia, the southern and central parts of Sumatra and the western parts of Sarawak. Some air quality stations in western parts of Peninsular Malaysia recorded Unhealthy levels, while some air quality stations in Kalimantan and Sumatra reported Unhealthy to Hazardous levels. The full extent of the hotspot and smoke haze situation over the southern ASEAN region could not be determined due to extensive cloud cover. It was dry over the northern ASEAN region overnight, except for some showers over the Philippines and the southern parts of the sub-region. Hotspot activity over the northern ASEAN region remained low.
